GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Prior to the declaration of correct weight STWDS considered a protest lodged by tnr of 3rd Vs the 2nd placed, alleging interference near the 150m. After taking evidence & viewing the Patrol Films, it was identified that 2nd & 3rd were racing tight from the 150m resulting in both runners slightly brushing. Having regard to the incident & taking into account the margin, Stewards could not be comfortably satisfied that had the incident not occurred, 3rd would have finished in advance of 2nd. Protest dismissed. Raced keenly through the early & middle stages. laid in 300m, bumped another rnr.
